title: Vietnamese Language 3 (Vietnamese Language in Economics and Business 3)

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Recall, understand, and use vocabulary and terms related to various topics.
Apply grammar rules to enhance language skills.
Listen and record key information from news broadcasts, dialogues, speeches, and lectures related to specific topics.
Speak confidently on topics for 5-7 minutes in front of class with or without preparation.
Write clearly and coherently about topics with correct style and grammar.
Utilize research skills to gather information on topics covered in the course.
Recognize the importance of self-motivation in developing language skills.
Work effectively in groups and solve problems related to language.
